name: Label
statusNote: Label has been stable for years; the alpha flag reflects Primer React's review process, not an unsettled API. It was accessibility-reviewed on 2025-01-08.
summary: A small outlined pill of text that adds metadata or a status to an object (Beta, Private, Required). Choose it over StateLabel when the label is not the object's open/closed state, over Token when the user cannot select or remove it, and over IssueLabel for user-defined colours.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The label's content (children). Short: one or two words.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: A fixed-height pill with a 1px border in the variant's colour and no fill; the text is centred vertically.

anatomy.name: Text
anatomy.description: One line of small body text at medium weight with a line height of 1, in the variant's text colour.

variants.description: Default text in a default border.
Default text in a border drawn in the default text colour: the strongest neutral outline.
Muted text in a muted border: the quietest label.
Accent text in an accent-emphasis border.
Success text in a success-emphasis border.
Attention text in an attention-emphasis border.
Severe text in a severe-emphasis border.
Danger text in a danger-emphasis border.
Done text in a done-emphasis border.
Sponsors text in a sponsors-emphasis border.
24px tall, 8px side padding; the text stays small body size.

layout.text: Height is exactly --base-size-20 (20px) at small and --base-size-24 (24px) at large, border included; there is no vertical padding and the text is centred in the height.
Side padding is --base-size-6 (6px) at small and --base-size-8 (8px) at large; width hugs the text.
Text is small body size (12px at both sizes), medium weight, line height 1, never wrapping.
The border is 1px solid in the variant's border colour with a full radius; the background is transparent, so the label shows the surface it sits on.

states.text: Label has one static appearance per variant: no hover, press, focus or disabled styling.

behaviour.text: Label is not interactive. A caller may render it as another element (a link, say) but the module adds no interaction styling for that.

accessibility.role: none (a generic inline span; its text is read in reading order)
semantics: The text is the only content; colour carries no meaning on its own, so the text must say the status.

notes.text: Most coloured variants draw their border in a --bgColor-<role>-emphasis token, not the --borderColor-<role>-emphasis one that also exists; danger alone reads --borderColor-danger-emphasis, and primary's border is --fgColor-default. Read exactly the token listed per variant, because themes bind the bg and border emphasis tokens apart.
Label does not read the --label-<hue>-* component tokens; those belong to IssueLabel. Label composes functional tokens only.

Long text never wraps and never truncates: white-space is nowrap and there is no max-width or overflow rule, so the pill grows and overflows its parent. A native build that needs a bound must add its own ellipsis.
